# Price the week, not the loaded mile.

> Free owner-operator CPM calculator: fuel, truck note, insurance, and deadhead miles in one week. See all-in cost per mile and the loaded rate that actually covers the empty ones.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
